module: Flowgraph node 'Get Camera Mode' (repeat_instant category). Gives the name of the active camera mode (core_camera.getActiveCamName(0)) on the output 'mode'. Depends on core_camera.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Writes the name of the active camera mode to the output.
